The '''Baron of Filby''' was a title<ref name="LiveAction">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref> that shared its name with the [[Filby system/Legends|Filby system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], it was held by [[Logan Erstar]], who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] at a [[Logan Erstar's homeworld|world]] that at one point had [[Monarchy/Legends|royal]] families.<ref name="LiveAction" />
